scope: Private CPU verification of raw equality, timing manifests, installed-driver resource reports and static instruction delivery

baseline.timing_scope: Each dispatch independently minimizes a different frame; this sum is not an observed complete frame

candidate.timing_scope: Each dispatch independently minimizes a different frame; this sum is not an observed complete frame

driver_gemm.instruction_count_scope: Static ISA delivery; not runtime instruction counts
driver_gemm.subgroup_caveat: Driver executable property reports subgroup=128; pipeline keys request subgroup=32 for native optimized kernels. No claim of wave128 execution.
driver_gemm.spills_caveat: Driver report has scratch bytes, but does not independently expose spill counts

driver_window.instruction_count_scope: Static ISA delivery; not runtime instruction counts
driver_window.subgroup_caveat: Driver executable property reports subgroup=128; pipeline keys request subgroup=32 for native optimized kernels. No claim of wave128 execution.
driver_window.spills_caveat: Driver report has scratch bytes, but does not independently expose spill counts

limitations: All timings are neural inference only; no bridge, FSR, presentation or game FPS.
Instrumented profiling is separate from ordinary benchmark timings.
Strict model proofs use synthetic features; game sequence and visual review are separate gates.
No private buffers or ISA text are copied into this scalar audit.
